paginationNote: list_deployments returns at most 20 rows regardless of the limit argument. The window was walked with until=<oldest created> until a page returned fewer than 20 rows: 20 + 20 + 20 + 18 = 78. The first emission of this snapshot took page 1 alone (20 rows spanning 13.5h) and reported it as a 7-day total, which is why it read GREEN on 20 deploys.

alerts: count_error=2 meets the >=2/week RED threshold. Both are preview builds on security-patch branches (Undici pins, Next AVIF RCE) that failed and were fixed on the next push. Branch-specific, not infrastructure. This is the only metric outside tolerance.

duration_p50=192s is GREEN for the first time since this snapshot series began (W33 535s, W34 526s, W35 535s). Turbopack plus the .vercelignore and prebuild-cache work has roughly a third off the previous median.
count_total=78 and total_build_minutes=279 are both comfortably GREEN. W35's 230 deploys / 1684 minutes was the peak.

count_skipped=10 of 78 (12.8%). All ten are supersession cancels on rapid successive pushes. Zero are ignoreCommand skips of a branch that matched main, because that check did not exist on main until this pull request: it lived only on two unmerged agent branches, and the version there was conditioned on origin/main resolving, which it does not in Vercel's shallow preview clone.

Bursts, not steady rate, dominate the frequency leg. 20 of the 78 (26%) landed inside one 13.5h span, and six of those inside 400 seconds when several agent branches were pushed at once. The same push fired builds across arcanea-ai-app, dpi-open-core, starlight-research-hub and starlightintelligence-ai simultaneously; 5 of that cross-project batch failed.
